page_metadata.page_title: GlowVwap | Anchored VWAP Pullback Strategy by blitz_algo
page_metadata.meta_description:
This strategy trades pullbacks in the direction of an anchored VWAP trend. The VWAP restarts at each new day, session, week or month. It is weighted by volume, with bands built from the volume-weighted standard deviation. That deviation has an ATR-based floor, so the bands don’t collapse right after the anchor.

The strategy waits for the anchor to mature, which is 60 minutes by default. Then it needs three things to agree before it looks for an entry:

Accepted side. Price must close beyond …

pine_source_verbatim:
//@version=6
strategy("AVWAP Pullback Glow [Strategy]", shorttitle = "AVWAP-GLOW", overlay = true,
     initial_capital = 10000, default_qty_type = strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value = 10,
     commission_type = strategy.commission.percent, commission_value = 0.02, slippage = 2,
     pyramiding = 0, calc_on_every_tick = false, process_orders_on_close = false)

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CORE IDEA (one setup, trade with the anchored-VWAP trend only)
//   1) Anchored VWAP + volume-weighted σ bands, reset each anchor.
//   2) Trend = accepted closes beyond VWAP + rising/falling VWAP + no chop.
//   3) Prior-anchor bridge = directional bias (block trades against a confirmed migration).
//   4) Entry = pullback into the VWAP zone that closes back on the trend side.
//   5) Risk = structural stop beyond VWAP, 2R target, breakeven at 1R, VWAP-lost exit, flat at anchor end.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//Thumbnail edit
// ─────────────────────────── INPUTS ───────────────────────────
string gT = "Trading"
string dirMode     = input.string("Both", "Direction", options = ["Both", "Long Only", "Short Only"], group = gT)
float  pullZ       = input.float(0.50, "Pullback: low/high within this many σ of VWAP", minval = 0.0, maxval = 2.0, step = 0.05, group = gT)
int    maxTrades   = input.int(2, "Max trades per anchor period", minval = 1, group = gT)

string gR = "Risk"
float  riskPct     = input.float(0.5, "Risk per trade (% of equity)", minval = 0.05, maxval = 5.0, step = 0.05, group = gR)
float  maxPosPct   = input.float(100.0, "Max position size (% of equity)", minval = 5.0, maxval = 500.0, step = 5.0, group = gR)
float  stopK       = input.float(1.0, "Stop distance beyond VWAP (× σeff)", minval = 0.3, step = 0.1, group = gR)
float  minStopATR  = input.float(0.75, "Min stop size (× ATR)", minval = 0.1, step = 0.05, group = gR)
float  maxStopATR  = input.float(3.0, "Skip trade if stop larger than (× ATR)", minval = 0.5, step = 0.1, group = gR)
float  rrMult      = input.float(2.0, "Target (R multiple)", minval = 0.5, step = 0.25, group = gR)
float  beR         = input.float(1.0, "Move stop to breakeven at (R)", minval = 0.3, step = 0.1, group = gR)
bool   flatAtAnchor = input.bool(true, "Flatten at each new anchor", group = gR)

string gA = "Anchor"
string anchorMode  = input.string("Day", "Anchor period", options = ["Session", "Day", "Week", "Month"], group = gA)
float  srcIn       = input.source(hlc3, "Price source", group = gA)
bool   useVolume   = input.bool(true, "Volume weighted (off = TWAP)", group = gA)
int    atrLen      = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval = 1, group = gA)
float  floorK      = input.float(0.4, "σ floor (× ATR)", minval = 0.0, step = 0.05, group = gA)
int    matMinutes  = input.int(60, "Maturity (minutes after anchor)", minval = 0, group = gA)
float  b1K         = input.float(1.0, "Inner band (× σeff)", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gA)
float  b2K         = input.float(2.0, "Outer band (× σeff)", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = gA)

string gF = "Trend filters"
int    accBars     = input.int(2, "Accepted closes to confirm a side", minval = 1, group = gF)
float  hystK       = input.float(0.15, "Dead-zone around VWAP (× σeff)", minval = 0.0, step = 0.05, group = gF)
int    slopeBars   = input.int(5, "VWAP slope lookback (bars)", minval = 1, group = gF)
int    rotWin      = input.int(14, "Chop window (bars)", minval = 4, group = gF)
int    chopMax     = input.int(3, "Side flips in window = chop", minval = 2, group = gF)

string gM = "Prior-anchor bridge (bias)"
bool   useBridge   = input.bool(true, "Use bridge bias", group = gM)
string migFilter   = input.string("Block opposite", "Bias mode", options = ["Off", "Block opposite", "Require agree"], group = gM)
float  migEntry    = input.float(1.0, "Migration: new VWAP displacement (old σ)", minval = 0.3, step = 0.1, group = gM)
float  anchorEntry = input.float(0.20, "Migration: continued-anchor displacement (old σ)", minval = 0.05, step = 0.05, group = gM)
float  bridgeEntry = input.float(0.35, "Bridge: return distance (old σ)", minval = 0.1, step = 0.05, group = gM)

string gV = "Visuals"
bool   showGlow    = input.bool(true, "VWAP glow", group = gV)
bool   showBands   = input.bool(true, "Gradient bands", group = gV)
bool   showBridge  = input.bool(true, "Prior equilibrium + bridge fill", group = gV)
bool   showLevels  = input.bool(true, "Live trade levels", group = gV)
bool   showMarkers = input.bool(true, "Entry markers", group = gV)
bool   showPanel   = input.bool(true, "Dashboard", group = gV)

// ─────────────────────────── COLOURS ───────────────────────────
color cUp     = #00e5b0
color cDn     = #ff4d6d
color cNeu    = #8f9bb3
color cBridge = #3d9bff

// ─────────────────────────── ANCHOR & VWAP ENGINE ───────────────────────────
float atr = nz(ta.atr(atrLen))
float w   = useVolume and nz(volume) > 0 ? volume : 1.0
int matBars = math.max(int(math.ceil(matMinutes * 60.0 / timeframe.in_seconds())), 3)

bool chD = timeframe.change("D")
bool chW = timeframe.change("W")
bool chM = timeframe.change("M")
bool chS = session.isfirstbar
bool newAnchor = anchorMode == "Session" ? chS : anchorMode == "Week" ? chW : anchorMode == "Month" ? chM : chD

var float p0   = na
var float sW   = 0.0
var float sWD  = 0.0
var float sWD2 = 0.0
var int   n    = 0
var float vw   = na
var float sig  = na

var float refVw  = na
var float refSig = na
var float refW   = na
var bool  separated = false

var int runUp = 0
var int runDn = 0
var int gate  = 0
var int lastSide = 0
var int tradesAnchor = 0

bool resetNow = newAnchor or na(p0)
if resetNow
    if n >= 3 and not na(vw) and nz(sig) > 0 and sW > 0
        refVw  := vw
        refSig := math.max(sig, syminfo.mintick)
        refW   := sW
    else
        refVw  := na
        refSig := na
        refW   := na
    p0 := srcIn
    sW := 0.0
    sWD := 0.0
    sWD2 := 0.0
    n := 0
    separated := false
    runUp := 0
    runDn := 0
    gate := 0
    lastSide := 0
    tradesAnchor := 0

float dPx = srcIn - p0
sW   += w
sWD  += w * dPx
sWD2 += w * dPx * dPx
n    += 1
float mDev = sWD / sW
vw  := p0 + mDev
sig := math.sqrt(math.max(sWD2 / sW - mDev * mDev, 0.0))

float sEff   = math.max(nz(sig), floorK * atr)
bool  mature = n >= matBars and sEff > 0
float z      = mature ? (close - vw) / sEff : na
float dz     = hystK * sEff

// ─────────────────────────── BRIDGE (prior anchor) ───────────────────────────
bool  refValid = not na(refVw) and not na(refSig) and not na(refW)
float newShare = refValid ? sW / (refW + sW) : na
float disp     = refValid ? (vw - refVw) / refSig : na
float contDisp = refValid ? newShare * disp : na
float contVw   = refValid ? refVw + newShare * (vw - refVw) : na
if refValid and math.abs(disp) >= migEntry
    separated := true

int migSt = 0   // 1 up migration, -1 down migration, 2 bridged
if useBridge and refValid and mature
    if math.abs(disp) >= migEntry and math.abs(contDisp) >= anchorEntry
        migSt := disp > 0 ? 1 : -1
    else if separated and math.abs(disp) <= bridgeEntry
        migSt := 2

// ─────────────────────────── TREND STATE ───────────────────────────
runUp := close > vw + dz ? runUp + 1 : 0
runDn := close < vw - dz ? runDn + 1 : 0
if mature
    if runUp >= accBars
        gate := 1
    else if runDn >= accBars
        gate := -1

int side = mature ? (close > vw + dz ? 1 : close < vw - dz ? -1 : 0) : 0
bool flip = side != 0 and lastSide != 0 and side != lastSide
if side != 0
    lastSide := side
int rot = int(math.sum(flip ? 1 : 0, rotWin))

bool chop    = rot >= chopMax
bool slopeUp = n > slopeBars and vw > nz(vw[slopeBars])
bool slopeDn = n > slopeBars and vw < nz(vw[slopeBars])
int  rgS     = not mature ? 0 : chop ? 2 : gate      // 0 immature, 2 chop, 1 up, -1 down

// ─────────────────────────── SIGNALS ───────────────────────────
bool allowLong  = dirMode != "Short Only"
bool allowShort = dirMode != "Long Only"
bool flat       = strategy.position_size == 0
bool canTrade   = mature and flat and not chop and tradesAnchor < maxTrades and atr > 0

bool migOkL = migFilter == "Off" or not (useBridge and refValid) or (migFilter == "Block opposite" ? migSt != -1 : migSt == 1)
bool migOkS = migFilter == "Off" or not (useBridge and refValid) or (migFilter == "Block opposite" ? migSt != 1 : migSt == -1)

float lowZ  = (low - vw) / sEff
float highZ = (high - vw) / sEff

bool pullLong  = rgS == 1  and slopeUp and lowZ <= pullZ  and lowZ >= -stopK  and close > vw + dz and close > open and z < b2K
bool pullShort = rgS == -1 and slopeDn and highZ >= -pullZ and highZ <= stopK and close < vw - dz and close < open and z > -b2K

float rdL = math.max(close - (vw - stopK * sEff), minStopATR * atr)
float rdS = math.max((vw + stopK * sEff) - close, minStopATR * atr)

bool longSig  = canTrade and allowLong  and pullLong  and migOkL and rdL <= maxStopATR * atr
bool shortSig = canTrade and allowShort and pullShort and migOkS and rdS <= maxStopATR * atr

var float riskDist = na
var bool  beArmed  = false
var float curEntry = na
var float curStop  = na
var float curTgt   = na

float riskCash = strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0
float capPct   = strategy.equity * maxPosPct / 100.0

if longSig
    float qty = math.min(riskCash / (rdL * syminfo.pointvalue), capPct / (close * syminfo.pointvalue))
    if qty > 0
        riskDist := rdL
        tradesAnchor += 1
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty = qty, comment = "Pullback L")
        strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop = close - rdL, limit = close + rrMult * rdL)
else if shortSig
    float qty = math.min(riskCash / (rdS * syminfo.pointvalue), capPct / (close * syminfo.pointvalue))
    if qty > 0
        riskDist := rdS
        tradesAnchor += 1
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty = qty, comment = "Pullback S")
        strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop = close + rdS, limit = close - rrMult * rdS)

// ─────────────────────────── TRADE MANAGEMENT ───────────────────────────
if strategy.position_size == 0
    beArmed := false
    curEntry := na
    curStop := na
    curTgt := na
else if not na(riskDist)
    float avg  = strategy.position_avg_price
    float dirS = strategy.position_size > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0
    if not beArmed and dirS * (close - avg) >= beR * riskDist
        beArmed := true
    curEntry := avg
    curStop  := beArmed ? avg + dirS * syminfo.mintick : avg - dirS * riskDist
    curTgt   := avg + dirS * rrMult * riskDist
    if strategy.position_size > 0
        strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop = curStop, limit = curTgt)
        if runDn >= accBars
            strategy.close("Long", comment = "VWAP lost")
    else
        strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop = curStop, limit = curTgt)
        if runUp >= accBars
            strategy.close("Short", comment = "VWAP lost")

if flatAtAnchor and newAnchor and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment = "New anchor")

// ─────────────────────────── VISUALS ───────────────────────────
color rgCol = rgS == 1 ? cUp : rgS == -1 ? cDn : cNeu
color stCol = migSt == 1 ? cUp : migSt == -1 ? cDn : migSt == 2 ? cBridge : cNeu

float vwP = newAnchor ? na : vw

// glow layers (wide, faint -> narrow, bright) then the core line
plot(showGlow ? vwP : na, "Glow outer", color.new(rgCol, 94), 15, plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane)
plot(showGlow ? vwP : na, "Glow mid",   color.new(rgCol, 86), 9,  plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane)
plot(showGlow ? vwP : na, "Glow inner", color.new(rgCol, 72), 5,  plot.style_linebr, display = display.pane)
pVw = plot(vwP, "Anchored VWAP", rgCol, 2, plot.style_linebr)

// gradient bands: transparent at VWAP, solid toward the outer band
float vwB  = showBands and not newAnchor ? vw : na
float b2uV = showBands and not newAnchor ? vw + b2K * sEff : na
float b2dV = showBands and not newAnchor ? vw - b2K * sEff : na
pB2u = plot(b2uV, "Outer band +", color.new(rgCol, 80), 1, plot.style_linebr)
pB2d = plot(b2dV, "Outer band -", color.new(rgCol, 80), 1, plot.style_linebr)
plot(showBands and not newAnchor ? vw + b1K * sEff : na, "Inner band +", color.new(rgCol, 65), 1, plot.style_linebr)
plot(showBands and not newAnchor ? vw - b1K * sEff : na, "Inner band -", color.new(rgCol, 65), 1, plot.style_linebr)
fill(pB2u, pVw, top_value = b2uV, bottom_value = vwB, top_color = color.new(rgCol, 72), bottom_color = color.new(rgCol, 100), title = "Upper gradient")
fill(pVw, pB2d, top_value = vwB, bottom_value = b2dV, top_color = color.new(rgCol, 100), bottom_color = color.new(rgCol, 72), title = "Lower gradient")

// VWAP <-> close fill: stronger the further price is stretched
pCl = plot(close, "Close link", na, display = display.none, editable = false)
int stretchT = int(92 - 34 * math.min(math.abs(nz(z)) / b2K, 1.0))
fill(pVw, pCl, mature and not newAnchor ? color.new(rgCol, stretchT) : na, "VWAP to close")

// bridge: frozen prior equilibrium + maturity-weighted fill between new and continued VWAP
bool bridgeVis = showBridge and refValid and not newAnchor
plot(bridgeVis ? refVw : na, "Prior equilibrium", color.new(cNeu, 30), 1, plot.style_linebr)
pNew  = plot(bridgeVis ? vw : na, "Bridge new", na, display = display.none, editable = false)
pCont = plot(bridgeVis ? contVw : na, "Bridge continued", color.new(cNeu, 55), 1, plot.style_linebr)
fill(pNew, pCont, bridgeVis ? color.new(stCol, int(92 - 45 * nz(newShare))) : na, "Reset bridge")

// live trade levels
bool inTrade = strategy.position_size != 0
pEnt = plot(showLevels and inTrade ? curEntry : na, "Entry", color.new(cNeu, 20), 1, plot.style_linebr)
pStp = plot(showLevels and inTrade ? curStop : na, "Stop", color.new(cDn, 10), 1, plot.style_linebr)
pTgt = plot(showLevels and inTrade ? curTgt : na, "Target", color.new(cUp, 10), 1, plot.style_linebr)
fill(pEnt, pTgt, showLevels and inTrade ? color.new(cUp, 88) : na, "Target zone")
fill(pEnt, pStp, showLevels and inTrade ? color.new(cDn, 88) : na, "Risk zone")

plotshape(showMarkers and longSig,  "Long",  shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, cUp, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showMarkers and shortSig, "Short", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, cDn, size = size.tiny)

// ─────────────────────────── DASHBOARD ───────────────────────────
f_num(float x, string fmt) =>
    na(x) ? "--" : str.tostring(x, fmt)

f_rg(int s) =>
    s == 1 ? "UP TREND" : s == -1 ? "DOWN TREND" : s == 2 ? "CHOP" : "IMMATURE"

f_mig(int s, bool ok) =>
    not ok ? "NO PRIOR ANCHOR" : s == 1 ? "UP MIGRATION" : s == -1 ? "DOWN MIGRATION" : s == 2 ? "BRIDGED" : "UNRESOLVED"

var table panel = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, bgcolor = color.new(chart.bg_color, 12), frame_color = color.new(cNeu, 50), frame_width = 1, border_width = 1, border_color = color.new(cNeu, 80))
if barstate.islast and showPanel
    float wr = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? strategy.wintrades / strategy.closedtrades * 100.0 : na
    string posTxt = strategy.position_size > 0 ? "LONG" : strategy.position_size < 0 ? "SHORT" : "FLAT"
    table.cell(panel, 0, 0, "AVWAP GLOW", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 0, f_rg(rgS), text_color = rgCol, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 1, "Bridge bias", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 1, f_mig(migSt, refValid), text_color = stCol, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 2, "z (σ from VWAP)", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 2, f_num(z, "#.00"), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 3, "Slope / flips", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 3, (slopeUp ? "UP" : slopeDn ? "DOWN" : "FLAT") + " / " + str.tostring(rot), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 4, "Trades this anchor", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 4, str.tostring(tradesAnchor) + " / " + str.tostring(maxTrades), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 5, "Net profit", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 5, str.tostring(strategy.netprofit, format.mintick), text_color = strategy.netprofit >= 0 ? cUp : cDn, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 6, "Win rate (trades)", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 6, f_num(wr, "#.0") + "% (" + str.tostring(strategy.closedtrades) + ")", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 0, 7, "Position", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(panel, 1, 7, posTxt, text_color = strategy.position_size > 0 ? cUp : strategy.position_size < 0 ? cDn : chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
